narr: Thunderstorms formed along a stationary frontal boundary extending from northeastern Pennsylvania into eastern New York which brought localized flash flooding to the region.
ev: Bissell Road washed out in the Town of Franklin. Rushing water and boulders destroyed a culvert and the road covering.
